title: Silly Sentence Builder
shareTitle: Silly Sentence Builder — Make a Felt-Puppet Story
description: Choose a felt friend, a funny action, and a magical place, then hear the complete sentence and watch the exact pieces perform together on a cozy puppet stage.
learningGoals: Build and rehearse complete subject-action-place sentences
Hear sentence parts combined in left-to-right order
Expand an oral sentence with a descriptive manner phrase
interactionModel: custom DOM felt-theater builder with guided category choices, tap-or-drag assembly, reversible slots, compositional puppet reveals, and three-round story quilts
feedbackModel: Every accepted picture speaks and settles into its matching stitched slot; completed sentences unlock an explicit show button, recorded read-aloud, semantic layered animation, celebration, replay/edit controls, and a three-show quilt payoff.
credits: Kaigani; original felt production art made with GPT Image 2 and approved local Krea 2; platform teacher narration made with Qwen voice clone and Whisper QA. Built with Codex for QLOBE Kids.
